items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: J. Hill did a bunch of them.

ctx.x: The great singer. Had great charts, really good charts. J. Hill did a bunch of them. And that was a great job too. He worked Vegas a lot, every year. And occasionally we’d go out for maybe like a weekend to Philadelphia to Palumbo’s or something and go out. But I worked with him and actually I replaced Buddy Childers there. Buddy Childers was the trumpet player for Vic and I replaced him. I stayed for a couple of years. And then my children were really small I got asked to play at the ABC Television in Los…
